zoe (marketing): quick ask — need a tiny smokepack for launch blog + webinar. Can eng/runtime produce reproducible runs we can cite? 150 samples per variant, raw payloads, seeds, CLI, and one-paragraph caveats. Deadline: Thu EOD. @matt @sam

matt (eng-runtime): can do. which variants? warmup? cache?

zoe (marketing): two variants: 7b-int8 (quant) and 13b-fp16. Run cold (warmup=0) and warmed (warmup=20). For 13b include warmed+prefix-cache.

sam (eng-ml): will supply prompt set and deterministic seeds (sampled, redacted).

matt (eng-runtime): plan: run on staging-gpu-small, batching=auto, collect p50/p90/p99, per-request timestamps, and produce artifacts: samples.jsonl, seeds.txt, cli.txt, caveats.md. ETA: Thu 4pm PST.

ci-bot: job queued: job-314159-01 on staging-gpu-small.

zoe (marketing): perfect — please add a one-line slide caption and a 1-sentence press blurb in caveats.md so copy can iterate. Thanks!
